title: Azizi Florence
summary: A residential community in Sharjah alongside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), with villa and townhouse designs, landscaped parkland and leisure amenities.

children.text: Azizi Florence brings together apartments, villas and townhouses in Sharjah alongside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), with landscaped parkland and neighbourhood amenities throughout the community.

The villa designs comprise four-, five- and six-bedroom homes over three floors. The townhouse designs include three- and four-bedroom homes arranged in four-, six- and eight-home groups, with a choice of corner and middle layouts.

Gardens, walking, running and cycling routes, sports courts, children's play areas and picnic areas create spaces for recreation and relaxation. Neighbourhood amenities include clubhouses, swimming pools, fitness and wellness facilities, cafes and electric-vehicle charging.
